indicators.name: Periodic Upsampling Grid Index
indicators.summary: Measures off-diagonal vs cardinal-axis high-frequency energy peaks associated with deconvolution or upsampling kernels.

indicators.name: High-Frequency Spectral Ratio
indicators.summary: Proportion of 2D-DFT spectral magnitude in outer Nyquist frequency bands; excessively low values can indicate synthetic smoothing.

indicators.name: Error Level Analysis (ELA) Variance
indicators.summary: Block-wise variance of JPEG Q=90 recompression residuals, highlighting regions compressed at mismatched quality levels.

indicators.name: Local Noise Residual Inconsistency
indicators.summary: Coefficient of variation across 8x8 Laplacian high-pass noise blocks; spliced or selectively airbrushed regions alter local noise uniformity.

indicators.name: Facial-Center vs Periphery Sharpness
indicators.summary: Compares Laplacian detail density in the central subject zone against peripheral background regions.

indicators.name: R-G Chrominance Cross-Correlation
indicators.summary: Pearson correlation across red and green color channels; unnatural skin smoothing or color transfer can shift channel coupling.

report.disclaimer: Frequency-domain spectra, ELA residuals, and texture maps are supporting forensic indicators only. They highlight statistical anomalies for human review and do not independently prove authenticity or manipulation.
